tease.h2:
Three truths about you
that numbers already know

card1.h: Why you repeat the same patterns
card1.p: It is not weakness. It is not bad luck. There is a mechanism encoded in your Life Path that sustains the cycles you keep trying to break — and it has a name.

card2.h: Where your greatest block is — and why it keeps coming back
card2.p: The block you feel around money, relationships, or purpose is not random. It sits at the exact point of tension between your Personality, your Soul, and your current life moment.

card3.h: What this season of your life is asking from you
card3.p: Every cycle has a different vibration. What worked before may be sabotaging you now — and what feels difficult may be exactly what this moment requires.

esferas.sub: Each sphere reveals a layer of who you are — how you act, what moves you within, and what you came here to become.

origem.p1: More than 2,500 years ago, Pythagoras discovered that numbers are not just quantities — they are the structure of reality. Each number carries a unique vibrational frequency that manifests in personality, patterns, and purpose.
origem.quote: "This is not vague mysticism. It is a precise self-knowledge system that works with who you already are, revealing the patterns that govern your entire experience."
origem.quoteSource: — Rodrygo Murari, creator of the APN Method
origem.p2: The APN System (Applied Pythagorean Numerology) integrates this ancient wisdom with a deep reading of human behavior — mapping the Three Movements of Being: what you react to, what you manifest, and what you came here to become.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: If you recognized yourself in any of the 3 revealed points — the pattern, the sabotage, or the frequency — then yes. The complete map goes far beyond what you saw here.
faq.q2: Is it different from a horoscope?
faq.a2: Completely. Pythagorean numerology uses mathematics — your name and birth date generate numbers that are unique to you. There is no zodiac-sign generalization. Each map is individual.
faq.q3: How do I receive the map?
faq.a3: After payment, your complete Numerology Map is sent to your e-mail as a PDF. You keep it forever and can access it whenever you want.
